$description: Primitives: named paint, no roles. Nothing outside design/tokens/theme.json should reference these directly — a component that wants 'indigo' wants 'accent'.

mocha.$description: Mocha Mousse — the warm hue the neutrals are tinted with, and the landing aurora.

warm.$description: Neutrals, warm rather than grey. 950-800 carry the dark theme, 300-100 the light one.

slate.$description: Cool text greys. Deliberately not warm: body copy stays neutral against the warm ground.

signal.$description: State, not brand. Identical in both themes on purpose.
